calls.title: GB x Shiftkey - Org Structure
calls.summary: The discussion focused on the organizational structure of ShiftKey, emphasizing the distinct operations of its SaaS and Marketplace units, which serve different customer segments while maintaining centralized leadership. A key strategic decision was made to create separate GrowthBook enterprises for these two businesses to ensure independent management and minimize operational risks. The SaaS team has implemented feature flags but is still early in its experimentation journey, while the Marketplace team is just beginning its experimentation efforts, primarily in proof of concept mode. Separate permissions, naming conventions, and the need for streamlined contract management were also highlighted, culminating in an agreement to swiftly clone the SaaS GrowthBook account for the Marketplace.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, ShiftKey, SaaS, Marketplace, Feature Flags, Experimentation
